What is Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP)?

Think of It as a Hair Tattoo—But Way More Realistic

Imagine achieving a denser and more vibrant look without surgery or daily maintenance.

That’s exactly what Scalp Micropigmentation offers. By meticulously replicating your natural hair pattern, MPG enhances the appearance of thinning and bald areas, leaving you with undetectable, thicker, and denser hair.
Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP) is a non-invasive hair restoration technique where specially formulated pigments are deposited into the scalp in tiny dots to replicate natural hair follicles.

It’s perfect for men or women dealing with bald spots, thinning hair, visible scars, or even after a failed transplant.

The result? A natural-looking hairline, improved hair density, or a clean-shaven look—depending on your style goals.

Who Should Consider Scalp Micropigmentation?

If You Want a Low-Maintenance, Natural Hair Look—This Is for You

SMP isn’t just for baldness—it’s for anyone looking to enhance the appearance of their hair.
SMP is great for:

✅ Hair Thinning and Baldness: Whether you’re dealing with a receding hairline or a bald patch on the crown, MPG can provide coverage and increased density.

✅ Eyebrow Enhancement: For those seeking fuller eyebrows, Scalp Micropigmentation offers a natural-looking solution.

✅ Beard and Mustache Restoration: Men can achieve a fuller, denser beard and mustache with the precision of MPG.

✅ Scarring Alopecia: Scalp Micropigmentation effectively conceals scars caused by surgeries or injuries.

✅ Post-FUT Strip Surgery: Individuals who have undergone FUT strip surgery can opt for MPG to minimize the visibility of scars and achieve a natural result.

How Does SMP Work?

Detailed. Personalized. Natural-Looking. Every Dot Matters.

Our SMP specialists use precision tools and pigments that match your skin and hair color for the most realistic results.
✅ Step 1: Hairline Design & Color Match
We begin by understanding your goals—whether you want a defined hairline, thicker appearance, or scar camouflage—and match pigment shades to your skin and hair color.
✅ Step 2: Layered Pigment Application
Tiny, layered pigment deposits are placed in the scalp in natural hair patterns using a microneedle. The process usually takes 2 to 3 sessions for best results.
✅ Step 3: Healing & Touch-Up
Each session is spaced 1–2 weeks apart. Minor redness fades in 1–2 days, and final results become visible after full healing and optional touch-ups.
